verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents a few native multi-item actions: depositing multiple checks together, bundling packages into one shipment, and automation rules that handle incoming mail by rule. These are its own capabilities, but they are narrow and say nothing about general bulk selection or actions (e.g., bulk scan, tag, forward or shred) across many mail items. The API is only a vague claim, and the OpenAPI spec could not be found. Missing for 10: general bulk select-and-act on mail items in the UI, documented bulk/batch API endpoints, depth on automation-rule scope, independent or hands-on corroboration.
